islands.name: Forest
islands.subtitle: Friendly starters, runners and crest collectors.

species.name: Leafy
species.rationale: The familiar small starter anchors the collection.
species.note: Selected concept portrait; animation bank exists on main, not proof of final launch qualification.

species.name: Aquilops
species.rationale: Small beak and shield give a second friendly starter silhouette.
species.note: Selected concept portrait; animation bank exists on main, not proof of final launch qualification.

species.name: Pachycephalosaurus
species.rationale: A rounded dome makes the head instantly different.
species.note: Selected concept portrait; animation bank exists on main, not proof of final launch qualification.

species.name: Gallimimus
species.rationale: Long legs and small head add height and lightness.
species.note: Main movement/dig bank exists; happy/sleep and wider tester acceptance remain open.

species.name: Stegouros
species.rationale: A squat armored body contrasts with the upright runners.
species.note: Selected concept portrait; animation bank exists on main, not proof of final launch qualification.

species.name: Kentrosaurus
species.rationale: Shoulder and tail spikes supply a clear late-collection silhouette.
species.note: Local draft art/bank work now exists; not routed as a main gameplay species. Final integration and acceptance remain open.

species.name: Parasaurolophus
species.rationale: The long backward crest is a recognisable collection prize.
species.note: Local ranch/reveal accepted and device-tested; back-run retake and commit remain pending.

species.name: Shunosaurus
species.rationale: A low long neck and tail club finish Forest with a different body plan.
species.note: Selected concept portrait; animation bank exists on main, not proof of final launch qualification.

islands.name: Giants
islands.subtitle: The giant-scale sanctuary and its headline residents.

species.name: Shantungosaurus
species.rationale: Wide muzzle and chunky body make the big herbivore readable.
species.note: Existing runtime species; this selected concept look is not proof of matching production animation.

species.name: Dreadnoughtus
species.rationale: The towering vertical giant provides the island’s scale fantasy.
species.note: Existing runtime species; this selected concept look is not proof of matching production animation.

species.name: Giganotosaurus
species.rationale: The large land predator is a clear headline prize.
species.note: Tentatively liked working concept remake. Existing Giga bank is a separate approval; no new appearance approval implied.

species.name: Therizinosaurus
species.rationale: Long arms and sculpted claws add an unusual upright shape.
species.note: Existing runtime species; this selected concept look is not proof of matching production animation.

species.name: Spinosaurus
species.rationale: The sail and long snout separate it from Giga.
species.note: Existing runtime species; this selected concept look is not proof of matching production animation.

species.name: Diplodocus
species.rationale: Long horizontal neck and tail contrast with Dread’s height.
species.note: Existing runtime species; this selected concept look is not proof of matching production animation.

species.name: Deinocheirus
species.rationale: Proposed Giants replacement: a huge shaggy body and broad beak give a different silhouette from the long-necks and predators.
species.note: Long arms and broad body need clearance; overlaps Sucho’s large upright role.

species.name: Amargasaurus
species.rationale: Proposed Giants replacement: paired neck spines distinguish this smaller long-neck from Dreadnoughtus and Diplodocus.
species.note: Adds another sauropod alongside Giants and Nigersaurus; spine continuity needs work.

islands.name: Swamp
islands.subtitle: Four different body plans, grounded on connected banks.

species.name: Suchomimus
species.rationale: Keeps the current resident and a tall predator silhouette.
species.note: Runtime species exists; selected brighter moss-green concept still needs matching production work.

species.name: Carbonemys
species.rationale: A calm low turtle is a distinct collectible beside the dinosaurs.
species.note: Rigid shell and foot planting need a proof; scope it to the connected banks.

species.name: Edaphosaurus
species.rationale: Tall sail plus low body gives Swamp a different shape from Sucho.
species.note: Use ordinary grounded routes; sail and limb continuity still need animation work.

species.name: Nigersaurus
species.rationale: The broad muzzle and low long neck add a gentle herbivore.
species.note: Grounded bank routes; neck and muzzle identity need to survive the motion pass.

species.name: Diplocaulus
species.rationale: A wide boomerang head adds a strange, immediately recognisable shape.
species.note: Low splayed contact and wetland access need a separate proof.

species.name: Dilophosaurus
species.rationale: Proposed Swamp replacement: twin lengthwise crests bring a clear head shape, distinct from Suchomimus and Snow’s Cryolophosaurus.
species.note: Previously liked Riverbend concept, shown unchanged. Animation production, Swamp fit and runtime qualification remain open.

species.name: Sarcosuchus
species.rationale: Adds a recognisable crocodilian body.
species.note: Long torso/tail turns and bank/water staging expand production scope.

species.name: Titanoboa
species.rationale: The most unusual body plan in the Swamp set.
species.note: Continuous coils, crossings and believable whole-body motion carry the highest new risk.

islands.name: Snow
islands.subtitle: Feathers, armor and a woolly headline prize.

species.name: Yutyrannus
species.rationale: Keeps the current resident and Snow’s big friendly theropod.
species.note: Runtime species exists; this selected periwinkle Snow redesign is still a concept look.

species.name: Pachyrhinosaurus
species.rationale: A broad boss and frill create an armored-head counterpoint.
species.note: Preserve its boss instead of adding Trike’s long horns.

species.name: Borealopelta
species.rationale: Low armor and shoulder spikes give a third clear silhouette.
species.note: Keep the low body and shoulders readable against the snowy ground.

species.name: Woolly Mammoth
species.rationale: Wool, short tusks and a curled trunk make Snow feel special.
species.note: Deliberate stretch pick. Prove trunk/tusk continuity early; Cryolophosaurus is the safer swap.

species.name: Cryolophosaurus
species.rationale: Safest Mammoth replacement: familiar biped movement and a distinctive crest.
species.note: Its head/crest needs to stay distinct from the other pastel bipeds.

species.name: Sinosauropteryx
species.rationale: Adds a small, bright collector and more scale variety.
species.note: Long tail and feather cues need phone-size readability checks.

species.name: Iguanodon
species.rationale: Proposed Snow transfer: a sturdy beaked herbivore replaces Amargasaurus. Snow palette and ground contrast need a visual test.
species.note: Selected biped portrait; two-to-four-foot support transitions still need proof.

species.name: Citipati
species.rationale: A deep beak, crest and paired hands add a playful silhouette.
species.note: Shares an upright pastel role with Cryo and a feathered role with Fernlands Anzu.

islands.name: Fernlands
islands.subtitle: Rex, Trike, Anky and a new plated classic.

species.name: Rex
species.rationale: A beloved classic and Fernlands’ obvious predator.
species.note: Preserve the original approved Rex identity and existing motion work.

species.name: Trike
species.rationale: Frill and three horns make a familiar friendly anchor.
species.note: Preserve the original blue Trike. Current runtime is a separate production asset.

species.name: Ankylosaurus
species.rationale: Keeps Anky in the game and fills a low armored role.
species.note: Latest working Fernlands assignment replaces Heterodontosaurus; use original green identity.

species.name: Stegosaurus
species.rationale: The big coral plates complete a recognisable classics island.
species.note: One new package for this proposed four; compare plates with Forest Kentro/Stegouros.

species.name: Concavenator
species.rationale: A low hip hump and strong stripes give Fernlands another distinctive predator.
species.note: Selected final comparison; another carnivore beside Rex, not the rejected spotted baby-Rex.

species.name: Brachio
species.rationale: Your requested Fernlands long-neck. Proposed to take Iguanodon’s place, keeping the classic Stegosaurus.
species.note: Selected softer-smile concept. Existing Brachio bank remains a separate production asset.

species.name: Microraptor
species.rationale: Four feather panels make a striking small collectible.
species.note: Grounded scope only. Hindwing and fan-tail clearance need work; no flight mechanic selected.

species.name: Anzu
species.rationale: Adds a tall crest and feather-fan silhouette.
species.note: Use selected ivory/chestnut r2, not pink/teal r1. Long arms and fan clearance remain open.

revisionNote: Confirmed: 8 species per island, 40 at launch. Brachio moves to Fernlands and Paraceratherium leaves the launch cast. Other new homes below are proposals for review.

changeNotes.label: Brachio → Fernlands
changeNotes.detail: Your requested move. Proposed swap: Brachio takes Iguanodon’s place.

changeNotes.label: Giants replacements
changeNotes.detail: Proposed: Deinocheirus and Amargasaurus fill the Brachio and Paraceratherium spaces.

changeNotes.label: Two supporting swaps
changeNotes.detail: Proposed: Iguanodon moves to Snow; Dilophosaurus fills Deinocheirus’s Swamp space. Eight unique species remain on every island.
